# Why: loe.for_assets takes the latest drug substance patent
# effective() lets a substance patent set the date even where a regulatory exclusivity runs
# later. On NDA 217899 that puts the cliff two years inside NCE exclusivity (2029-08-14) and
# four inside orphan exclusivity (2031-08-14). Gilead's own table gives the orphan date.
# The date departs from the file's "as the filing states it" convention in one way: Gilead's
# Book gives the day. The day is taken because it is the one a primary source states.
